slovak: Stolár nemal presné miery, a napriek tomu tú policu zavesil úplne rovno.
answer: The carpenter didn't have exact measurements, but he was nevertheless hanging the shelf completely straight.

slovak: Zberateľ sa chystá zapožičať tie kresby malému mestskému múzeu.
answer: The collector is planning to lend the drawings to the small town museum.

slovak: Tomáš zamkol dielňu a zhasol všetky svetlá nad ponkom.
answer: Tomáš locks the workshop and turns off all the lights above the workbench.

slovak: Kiežby on ten starý orech nebol vyrúbal tak skoro.
answer: I wish that old walnut tree hadn't been cut down so soon.

slovak: On tvrdí, že on tú vitrínu dopĺňa novými vzorkami každý týždeň.
answer: He claims that he restocked the display case with new samples every week.

slovak: Vy ste nám tvrdili, že ten nový server nainštaloval váš kolega.
answer: You insisted to us that your colleague had set up the new server.

slovak: Kováč vykuje pre tú bránu dva nové pánty do konca týždňa.
answer: Two new hinges for the gate will be forged by the blacksmith by the end of the week.

slovak: V tejto dielni sa po ôsmej večer už nepracuje.
answer: You don't work in this workshop after eight in the evening.

slovak: Kým vlak stál v stanici, rušňovodič doplnil vodu do nádrže.
answer: While the train stands in the station, the engineer tops up the water in the tank.

slovak: On nalieva do tej panvice ešte trochu olivového oleja.
answer: He has poured a little more olive oil into the pan.

slovak: Budúcu sezónu on bude viesť tú dielňu a školiť dvoch nových učňov.
answer: Next season the workshop will be run and two new apprentices will be trained by him.

slovak: Vy budete tie nové stoličky ukladať do sály celé dopoludnie.
answer: You'll be moving the new chairs into the hall all morning.

slovak: Reštaurátorka nám vysvetlila, že ona z toho plátna odstránila tri vrstvy laku.
answer: The restorer explained to us that three layers of varnish had been removed from the canvas by her.

slovak: Elektrikár vymenil už všetky staré vypínače v našom dome.
answer: The electrician has already replaced all the old sockets in our house.

slovak: Keď sme my dorazili, Janka už rozložila celý stánok.
answer: When we arrived, Janka had already set up the whole stall.

slovak: Elektrikár vymenil už všetky staré vypínače v našom dome.
answer: The electrician has already replaced all the old switches in our house.

slovak: Ja večer zamknem tú zadnú bránku a zhasnem lampu.
answer: This evening I locked the back gate and turned off the lamp.
